items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Well, you know, I’ll tell you something, man. I’ve always had a thing about ­ - whatever you wanted to call what I was doing is all right with me because, you know, I just consider, we’re making music, that’s all. I mean in all honesty, I can’t say we were this or we were that, you know. So it was just being myself, man, the way I felt about it. You think that’s kind of a dumb answer but it’s a fact, you know.
Well again, you know, one of the interesting features of your band is that you like trombone players. You bring in Garnett Brown.
